Jira/BB codebase audit. Add --full for complete Slack report (default: digest)

Jira/BB PR audit. Usage: @bot jira-pr-audit [<repo-url>|<pr-url>] [--model <id>] [--team alice,bob] [--team MyTeam (Jira Eng Scrum Team filter — auto-detects your team from Jira account)] [--filter field=value] [--full]
Run scope-aware merge queue: collect ready PRs, group by scope, launch parallel lanes

Parallel test execution with test-impact analysis. Usage: @bot parallel-test <pr-url-or-number-or-branch> — e.g. @bot parallel-test https://github.com/org/repo/pull/24 OR @bot parallel-test main --repo https://github.com/org/repo
Show existing PR comments

PR audit — analyze PRs for spec/design/skills gaps. Usage: @bot pr-audit | @bot pr-audit <repo-url> | @bot pr-audit <pr-url> [<pr-url2>...] | @bot pr-audit ... --model <id> | @bot pr-audit --team alice,bob (filter by logins/names) | @bot pr-audit --team MyTeam (filter by Jira team field / GH label — auto-detects your team from Jira account) | @bot pr-audit --milestone <name> | @bot pr-audit --filter label=X (GH label) | @bot pr-audit --filter field=value (Jira field) | @bot pr-audit --full (full report in Slack, default: digest). Tracker (GH vs Jira/BB) auto-detected from URL.

Read-only AI review: risk score, blast radius, findings — no PR changes. Usage: @bot gate-review <pr-url> — e.g. @bot gate-review https://github.com/org/repo/pull/24
Security or risk scan
Classify PR blast-radius, risk tier, and scope lane. Usage: @bot scope <pr-url-or-number> — e.g. @bot scope https://github.com/org/repo/pull/24 OR @bot scope 24 --repo https://github.com/org/repo

Run any YGS skill. Usage: @bot skill <name> [--repo <url>] [--branch <name>] [--tracker github|jira] [--model <id>] [--service <image:tag>] [--service-port <port>] [--service-cmd <cmd>] [--service-args <args>] [-- instructions].
